category_title: Grade 6 student with behavioral exceptionalities and migration-related learning difficulties
minimal_context: Dwayne is sitting down in the resource room with the teacher to review a recently graded assignment.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Dwayne, let's sit down and look at your graded assignment from yesterday.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't want to look at it! It's stupid anyway!

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We need to review it. Look at this section here.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Stands up and speaks loudly) Why? I already did it! You're just going to tell me it's wrong!

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please sit back down. You know this is a D, so we have to go over the mistakes.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't care if it's a D! I'm not doing this grade 6 stuff, it's too hard and I'm not doing it!
